answer_1.quote: We present different entropy-based sampling approaches for the MDS task…These are specially well-suited for languages like German that have limited or unavailable MDS data.
answer_1.outputs: Generated abstractive summaries for multi‑document inputs

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of the entropy-based sampling approaches on our Multi-GeNews and the auto-hMDS datasets in terms of automatic ROUGE scores and extractive fragment density ρ.

answer_4.quote: We recruited three native German speakers to perform a manual evaluation on the Multi-GeNews test set…The objective of this task is to gain insights into human preferences of the generated summaries…Annotators were asked to rank the generated summaries according to informativeness and to judge the factuality of each text span.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators ranked summaries by informativeness and assessed each span for factuality (faithfulness to source articles).
